description: Create, track, assign, comment on, and close helpdesk tickets with real status transitions in a JSON-backed store.
name: helpdesk_ticket
provider_notes: Local JSON-backed store via ctx.memory (key aul:tickets_v1). No external helpdesk provider integrated; a Zendesk/Freshdesk connector would sit behind ctx.auth_get('helpdesk'). Demo runs against an in-memory FakeCtx, clearly labeled.
